location_description: This is the above and below ground sensor suite station #1 installed close to the new deep wells on the north facing slope close to PLM#2. This has a weather Station, Sampling Station, Soil moisture sensor, soil matrix potential sensor, CO2 flux chamber, Infrared camera, Net radiation sensor, Soil heat flux, temperature probes

This is an ecohydrology study site located at Trail Creek, within block 1 (treatment = control) of the ASCC project. The site consists of (1) an above-canopy pole with ET, energy and radiation fluxes, and meteorological sensors, and (2) a below-canopy tripod with soil, snow, and some limited meteorological/radiation sensors. Variables are monitored at half-hour intervals.
